name: Jue Shi Zhan Hun
summary: On the Canglan Continent, warriors cultivate their power by communicating with heaven and earth through their martial spirits. Our protagonist, Qin Nan, the young master of the Qin family, accidentally obtains a fragment of the soul of the God of War, a mysterious being from the ancient era. From that moment on, Qin Nan defies his destiny and begins an upward journey. Along his way, he meets beautiful immortal women, defeats celestial geniuses, and becomes invincible in all battles, eventually becoming a supreme and revered Celestial God.

name: Alumni Lovers
summary: We invite you to a date-matching show with eight singles who share their memories of their school days and a panels who are all prepared to make over 100 funny and frank comments to encourage a couple to be matched.

name: Raja, Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan
summary: They say that variety is the spice of life. Well, Indian cuisine is abundant with both spice and variety! But how did the Indian palate come to be this colorful? The answer lies in the royal kitchens of India. Indian Royalty are the custodians of the ancient culinary traditions. Raja, Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan takes us through the history of food prepared in the royal kitchens of India, whose blending of foreign imports, rare fowls, elaborate preparation methods and local herbs, created some of the best and most flavorful food in the country. We get to experience the tales of extravagance and eccentricity, of desperation and innovation, and of happy accidents. The royal love for creativity and uniqueness have led to a rich culinary tradition that makes Indian cuisine one of the most exciting ones in the world.

name: Bret Baier's 'The Campaign'
summary: Bret Baier's 'The Campaign' focuses on the most important topics to American voters and the effectiveness of how the candidates are campaigning on these issues.

name: India's Best Dancer
summary: India's Best Dancer showcases the journey of some of the best talent who, with their solo performances, will compete to win the title. The show promises to be the toughest dance reality show on Indian television and the makers have ensured to make it challenging at every step.

name: Costa!! de serie
summary: On the Spanish Costa Brava, the legendary club Costa is running at full speed again. However, success also means hard work and club owner Thomas is on the verge of burnout. When the doctor warns that he really needs to take it easy, permanent employees Esmee, Kay and Mike have to take over the management of the Costa. But then a neighbor and the municipality turn against the club and the team is once again faced with the big challenge of saving club Costa.

previousepisode.name: Zon, zee, sex en gevonden voorwerpen

name: Sunset x Vibes
summary: Ever since he can remember, Salil has been dreaming about a man in traditional Thai clothes. In every full moon night, that man will appear with the sweet scent of Kannika flowers and leave it beside a beautiful face that sleeps with sweet dreams before disappearing without a trace. However... when Salil turns 18 years old, that man disappeared from Salil's dream and life, not even saying goodbye. But then a strange feeling regurgitates his childhood memories again when Salil meets Suriyen, the CEO of the one of Asia's largest gem import company. From interns in the jewelry design department, Salil has to be a secretary in the president's office instead.

name: Dungeon People
summary: Clay has trained all her life to become the elite of the Thieves Guild. But since her father disappeared three years ago, she has put all her skills into searching for him in a dungeon filled with monsters and dangers. As she finally reaches depths never before equaled, she meets the manager of the dungeon... who invites her to join the staff! Arming traps, filling chests... through this new job, Clay will learn everything behind the scenes of a dungeon!

name: NCIS: Tony & Ziva
summary: Tony and Ziva have been raising their daughter, Tali, together. When Tony's security company is attacked, they must go on the run across Europe, try to figure out who is after them and maybe even learn to trust each other again so that they can finally have their unconventional happily ever after.

name: Ancient Powers
summary:
Ancient Powers will bring together the history of early Eastern and Western civilisations; using stunning documentary visuals and stylish CGI to tell the extraordinary story of the world's greatest ancient cultures on one epic timeline, stretching back 5,000 years.

Presented by world-leading historical specialists, each episode will use the very latest scientific and archaeological discoveries to reveal the tools, technologies, strategies and systems that decided the fate of Ancient Chinese, Egyptians, Indians, Greeks and Romans as they fought wars, battled the climate and established the rich and fascinating cultures which laid the foundations for the modern world.

The series will show why the fortunes of some civilisations rose while others fell; ultimately revealing how the destinies of Ancient East and West became inextricably connected as global trade routes took shape and China's economic success saw it locked in competition with the Roman Empire.

name: The Imposter
summary: Ghostwriter Tu Chacha finds herself reluctantly penning love letters for Miss Wen to hide her romantic escapades. Unintentionally, Tu Chacha develops feelings for the letters' recipient, Shen Buyan. In a bid to protect Shen Buyan from Miss Wen's father's schemes, Tu Chacha forms a makeshift family to dissuade him from pursuing Miss Wen. However, they soon fall into a trap laid by Miss Wen's father, resulting in severe repercussions for their masquerade. Together, Tu Chacha, Shen Buyan, and their makeshift family navigate a web of deceit, uncovering a shocking conspiracy along the way.

name: Taylor Swift vs. Scooter Braun: Bad Blood
summary: The $300M feud between Taylor Swift and Scooter Braun made headlines. But is Taylor bravely standing up for artistry and fighting the misogyny of the music industry, or has Scooter Braun been unfairly framed for what was just a business deal?

name: Toughest Forces on Earth
summary: Pirate ships. Desert warfare. Detonating underwater bombs. Go behind the scenes of secretive military units with a trio of veterans as your guides.

name: Dancing for the Devil: The 7M TikTok Cult
summary: After TikTok dancers join a management company and its associated church, unsettling details about the founder and their dark realities come to light.

previousepisode.name: Part III: Reap What You Sow

name: The Real CSI: Miami
summary: Jerry Bruckheimer, Anthony Zuiker and the minds behind the CSI scripted television franchise bring viewers a new true-crime series in The Real CSI: Miami. Each episode features gripping real-life crime cases and the cutting-edge forensic science used to solve them. The Real CSI: Miami highlights that at the heart of every story there's a victim and a family seeking justice.

name: Dreaming of a Freaking Fairytale
summary: In this 21st century hybrid fairy tale, a woman is determined to become a Cinderella, so she gets a job at an exclusive club and sets her sights on her future Prince Charming. He might be handsome and wealthy, but he's also an arrogant jerk with trust issues, and no interest in wom

name: Gummibär and Friends: The Gummy Bear Show
summary: Gummibär and Friends: The Gummy Bear Show is a brand new animated web series that follows the silly adventures of everyone's favorite gummy bear character and his friends Kala the cat and Harry the chameleon.

name: Living Stone
summary: Five couples engage in a life changing hike through Africa's most pristine wilderness in this game of survival and elimination to reach civilisation.

name: The Claman Countdown
summary: The close of the trading day is covered.

name: Kudlow
summary: Host Larry Kudlow leads roundtable discussions on the policies impacting the domestic and global economies and interviews with business influencers across the world.

name: Barron's Roundtable
summary: A weekly primetime series that features interviews with investors and major industry leaders about what to expect in the week ahead on Wall Street.

name: The Clues That Caught the Killer
summary: The Clues That Caught the Killer is a captivating three-part documentary series that dissects Britain's most shocking murders. And, in the face of gang violence, a lack of forensic evidence, and witnesses too terrified to speak, reveals how a team of hardworking investigators ultimately delivered justice for the victims and their devastated families.

name: The Evening Edit
summary: Host Elizabeth MacDonald interviews industry experts to get the inside scoop on the day's leading headlines as they relate to your wallet.

name: FBN's Wall Street
summary: FBN's Wall Street discusses emerging economic trends. Joined by veterans of Wall Street to talk about financial topics, with an emphasis on educating and empowering long-term investors. The show promises it's not just about investments, though, and includes all kinds of topics that affect people and their money.

name: WSJ at Large with Gerry Baker
summary: Wall Street Journal's editor at large Gerry Baker interviews industry leaders who impact Wall Street, Washington, D.C., and U.S. businesses.

name: The Bottom Line
summary: Dagen McDowell and Sean Duffy take on the hotly debated issues in the business and political world, plus the kitchen table topics that matter most to Americans.

name: The Big Money Show
summary: Taylor Riggs, Brian Brenberg and Jackie DeAngelis host an informative and fast-paced hour filled with business topics that impact everyone from Wall Street to the average person.

name: Ekstrem gjemsel
summary: In "Ekstrem gjemsel", 15 celebrities will compete in an extreme game of hide and seek. Presenter Victor Sotberg has his fellow presenters Christopher Omdahl and Robin Hofset with him, and together they will hunt down the participants who will be tasked with hiding as best as possible so as not to be found.

previousepisode.name: Jeg risikerer livet for Ekstrem Gjemsel!

name: Celebrity Hunted – Jede Spur kann dich verraten
summary: 10 celebrities face the impossible task: submerging for 10 days. Chased by professional investigators with only little money to live on. Dr. Wladimir Klitschko, Axel Stein, Tom Beck, Stefanie Giesinger, Vanessa Mai, Andreas Ferber, Kida Khodr Ramadan, Summer Cem, Diana Bill & Melisa Kocak are on their run through Germany. Who will remain undetected in this game?

name: Samuel og Bestefar
summary: Presenter and adventurer Samuel Massie has the world's best friend in his own grandfather. Now that his grandfather is approaching 82, Samuel wants to challenge his comfort zone, and take him out on one last great adventure.

name: Sandra usensurert
summary: Sandra usensurert is a series about one of Norway's most talked about girls, Sandra Lyng (27). After seven years of silence, she is now back on her own two feet - and with a new voice.

name: Se hva jeg kan
summary: Join us when 10 tough and brave children show what they can do! There will be speed, wild tricks, glittering dresses, back protectors and water splashes.

name: Singel
summary: We follow eight single Norwegians through ups and downs. In this unique documentary series, we get an honest insight into the many different sides of being young and single in Norway today.

previousepisode.name: «Du veit det kleine øyeblikket mellom fødselen og døden...?»

name: SNAKK med Linn Wiik
summary: Linn Wiik invites guests from Norwegian social and cultural life and addresses current topics.

name: Betty La Fea, La Historia Continúa
summary: Betty has not lived with Armando for two years after having found him in a compromising situation with Marcela. Excited about her daughter's return to Colombia, she tries to strengthen her bond with her, but pressure on Ecomoda and enemies from the past will do everything possible to keep her from both Mila and Armando.

name: Shrimad Ramayan
summary: Shrimad Ramayan brings to life the timeless Hindu epic, the Ramayana, with a deep commitment to authenticity, cultural reverence and contemporary sensibility. The epic narrative of the Ramayana is rooted in the two words, 'Ram' and 'Ayana.' 'Ram' represents the human incarnation of Lord Vishnu, while 'Ayana' signifies a journey. Thus, the Ramayana unfolds through the voyage of Ram, a mortal who ascended to become Purushottam, the paragon among men, transcending his own inherent limitations.

name: Pushpa Impossible
summary: Pushpa Impossible is the story about a feisty middle-aged woman having studied until class 9 in a Gujarati medium school and going back to school at the age of 44! She is boisterous, uncouth, impulsive, hardworking and an endearingly loveable mother of three children. She is Pushpa Patel hailing from a small town Patan in Gujarat and now residing at Bapodra Chawl in Mumbai. The show is a peek into her day-to-day struggles, her small victories, her Juggad, her shortcomings, and her constant pursuit of living a good life while struggling as a full-time mother and part-time businesswoman. The show is an autobiography of a mother, who decides to go back to school and change her life by impacting many lives!

name: Wagle Ki Duniya
summary: Three generations of the family live together, who share all their happiness and sorrows. Follow the story of this family as they bring laughter to each other's lives and will make your heart melt. A new generation of the old critically acclaimed show is here to take you on a roller coaster ride of emotions.

name: Kavya - Ek Jazbaa, Ek Junoon
summary: An ambitious young woman strives for the perfect balance between her dream career and a loving relationship. However, when these worlds collide, she grapples with the conflict between her roles as a daughter, a wife and an IAS officer. How will she tackle this challenging dilemma?

name: Barsatein - Mausam Pyar Ka
summary: A sensible and ambitious journalist joins a media company run by a suave maverick man. While united in their passion for honest and ground-breaking journalism, their contrasting characters immediately puts them at loggerheads. What will happen when she starts falling in love with him despite the red flags?

name: Wilde Ride
summary: A young girl's dreams of being a show jumping champion are dashed when her parents are killed. She goes to live with her dirt-bike-riding extended family in West Auckland. Made with the support of NZ on Air.

name: Dabangii: Mulgii aayi re aayi
summary: In a riveting tale of power, violence and family, a spirited young girl grapples with the contrast between who she believes her father is and who he actually turns out to be.

name: Kuch Reet Jagat Ki Aisi Hai
summary: Nandini is an independent and free-spirited young woman who, while honouring social customs, vehemently opposes societal malpractices camouflaged as traditions. Defying norms, she stands tall and bravely demands her dowry back from her in-laws.

name: Dhruv Tara - Samay Sadi Se Pare
summary: Love transcends time when a princess with a secret passion for healing people journeys 400 years in the future in search of a someone who can save her terminal brother. Amidst the wonderous modern world, the princess finds a talented neurosurgeon and, in the process discovers an unlikely bond of love. But will love be enough to compel him to travel to the past and help her and her brother?

name: Pashminna - Dhaage Mohabbat Ke
summary: A starry-eyed romantic falls in love at first sight with a hard-nosed businessman in a story of love, hope and heartbreak unfolding against the backdrop of soothing white snow-capped peaks, clear waters of the Dal Lake and golden chinar leaves in Kashmir. Will he be the answer to all her dreams, or will he become the gateway to the shattering truth of her past?

name: Aangan Aapno Kaa
summary: After raising three children alone, doting father Jaidev Sharma weathers the storms of seeing his adult daughters marry. Though Pallavi defies society's conventions and norms, she still seeks to be a dutiful daughter.

name: Mehndi Wala Ghar
summary: Mauli, an optimistic and determined woman who has never truly had a family of her own, sets out to mend the broken bonds of a family in Ujjain and reunite them in their ancestral home, the Mehndi Wala Ghar.

name: Vanshaj
summary: In a breathtaking whirlwind, a small-town girl unravels her hidden identity, thrusting her into a war with her own family members. Navigating fears and self-doubt, she must prove her mettle to inherit a real estate empire and forge a legacy that defies all expectations.

name: Mind Your Business
summary: Mind Your Business tells the story of the Williams family, which is in the business of celebrating some of life's biggest events with its music services. However, when it comes to the Williams' family affairs, there's a need for referees instead of DJs.

name: Concordia
summary:
Powered by AI surveillance, CONCORDIA is the town of the future and on the verge of expansion when twin catastrophes strike: the first ever murder and a hack of its AI tech. A team race to solve both crimes but, in doing so, uncover a shocking original sin that could bring everything crumbling down.

Concordia is the municipality of the future: a town built on surveillance and data collection not for nefarious self-serving purposes but for the greater good of society and its citizens. Its leadership's sole goal is to create a freer, fairer, and more humane society for today and tomorrow. By its 20th anniversary, Concordia is thriving an indisputable success. It's on the verge of expansion when twin catastrophes strike: the first ever murder and a hack of the town's impenetrable AI. Together, these events compromise the very foundation of the Concordia project and undermine any possibility of expansion. As the town's investigation unfolds, the story becomes a race against time to fix the hack, solve the murder, and get the expansion over the line. However, the team soon find themselves staring down a deeply disturbing original sin, a sin that undermines the promise of Concordia far more than any of these threats ever could…

name: Promiseland
summary: Take an intimate journey with NBA rookie Ja Morant as he navigates the perils of his first season. The challenges of 2019-2020 turn out to be more than the point guard could ever have imagined.

name: Thru
summary: THRU is an exciting reality knock out game. In each episode the teams follow a precise straight line from A to B and overcome the obstacles.

name: Takeshi's Castle
summary: Welcome to Takeshi's Castle, a Japanese game show involving 100 to 140 contestants who try to go through a series of silly physical challenges designed to eliminate them. Designed like a live-action Mario game, thousands of people have come to take on Takeshi's Castle to try and win the ¥1,000,000 prize but hardly anyone does!

name: Fiennes: Return to the Wild
summary: Sir Ranulph Fiennes, 'the greatest living explorer,' and his cousin, actor Joseph Fiennes, embark on a journey through Canada's British Columbia, traversing challenging landscapes, amid stunning scenery. On route they discuss Ran's historic triumphs, perilous expeditions, and recent Parkinson's diagnosis - using this shared experience to strengthen their familial bond and create lasting memories.

name: Murder in Mahim
summary: Police officer Shivajirao Jende and his friend, Retired journalist Peter Fernandes plunge into a murder investigation in Mumbai's underbelly. In a thrilling tale adapted from Jerry Pinto's critically acclaimed book, they uncover secrets of desire, greed, despair and also confront the shadows of their long lost friendship.

name: Μαύρα Μεσάνυχτα
summary: Thrasos' family becames inheritor of his dead brother, Apostolis, house and nightclub. But also he takes over the mafia of his brother. Everyday new troubles appear with police. Silvi the ex girlfriend of Apostolis, trying to take control more than the 5% of the club. Murders, fights and forbiden loves take place everyday. Last his wife, gothic daughter and teenage son keep making the things worse.

name: Ainsley's National Trust Cook Off
summary:
Ainsley and his chef friends cook al fresco in the walled kitchen gardens of the UK's finest National Trust stately homes. In each episode, Ainsley Harriott is joined by two guest chefs in the kitchen gardens of the historic estates who he will challenge to create and cook recipes using the bounty of the garden in an attempt to win the accolade of ‘Dish of the Day' whilst celebrating the abundance and beauty of fresh British produce grown by the Trust's team of staff and volunteers.

Alongside the fun of outdoor cooking and friendly competition, Ainsley meets the staff and volunteers of the Trust, and finds out about the work they do to maintain the gardens and estates - picking up handy gardening tips along the way.

name: Sword of the Demon Hunter: Kijin Gentoushou
summary: In the Edo era, young Jinta and his sister must flee their home, finding refuge in a mountain village. Years later, Jinta has grown into a skilled swordsman, sworn to protect the priestess of the village shrine. Charged with slaying a demon that threatens the shrine, Jinta confronts the malevolent creature in the forest, only to learn a shocking truth. The demon speaks of events one hundred and seventy years hence, when Jinta must confront the demon in the future. Thus begins an epic fantasy journey that spans multiple eras as Jinta hunts a demon through time and must come to terms with his own dark nature.

previousepisode.name: A Tale of Candy Apples and the Heavenly Maiden (Part 2)

name: The Feud
summary: The Feud introduces Emma and John Barnett who, along with their teenage daughter Beth, appear to live an idyllic life on Shelbury Drive. They're close friends with their neighbours, Sonia and Alan and despite their foibles, are also fond of older couple, Derek and Barbara. The close friendships in this seemingly peaceful street prove to be not quite as harmonious as they seem. When Emma and John decide to add a kitchen extension to their house, things quickly start to spin drastically out of control. As objections to the plans are raised, unexpected skeletons and life-threatening secrets begin to rise to the surface. Laced with menace, The Feud reveals how Emma's aspirational dream turns sharply into obsession, paranoia, and fear. One decision sets in motion events that have unforeseeable consequences for both her and the people living on her street.

name: Where in the Eff is Sarah Cincinnati?
summary: In this Carmen Sandiego send-up, everyone's flakiest friend, Sarah Cincinnati, asks for geography trivia help as she travels the world, getting lost and buzzed.

name: Shark
summary:
Shark offers viewers a surprising, insightful, and shocking look into the planet's most feared predator – the shark.

Each episode of Shark takes a look at different aspects of the shark, from vicious attacks, conservation, survivor stories to examining a shark's anatomy.

The series will also feature specially made crafted content that explores everything you ever wanted to know about shark attacks but were afraid to ask, reminding us why we need to value and look after these extraordinary beasts. The shark's anatomy, including their jaws, skin, eyes and teeth will be examined and the question of why sharks seemingly want to eat humans will be investigated.

name: Modern Day Gladiators
summary: Take an unprecedented look inside the vibrant world of esports. With the fanbase growing every year the competitions just keep getting bigger…and so do the cash prizes.

name: Spesialprestene
summary: We get to know priests in Norway who have an everyday life out of the ordinary. The special priests work in hospitals, in the police, in Norwegian prisons, on oil platforms, in the defense and at Gardermoen airport.

name: Suksesskolen
summary: Suksesskolen is a comedy drama series about a college that likes young people to succeed. The series is packed with music videos and questions what success really is.

name: All Rise
summary: A group of legal interns enter a high-stakes battle for the ultimate job offer. In this fierce jungle of competition, they must discover the truly fulfilling opportunities that resonate with their lives.

name: Jade's Fateful Love
summary: To protect her eldest sister, Yueling, the Youngest Princess of Dongyu, was married to Beishuo. By accident, she married Zhou Shiyu, the North Prince of Beishuo. The trip to the Capital City of Beishuo was full of assassinations. A jade pendant activated the Time Gate. Yueling and Zhou Shiyu had repeated reincarnations and improved themselves together, from striving to change their destiny to shouldering the national cause. As they grew together, they fell in love with each other.

name: Suverene Helter
summary: Suverene helter is a documentary series about some very special, but hitherto unknown, Norwegian athletes and their path towards the big event, the Special Olympics in Los Angeles 2015.

name: Sykkelreparatørene
summary: Spring is here and the time has come to get the bike out of the garage or shed. Through five episodes of Cykkelreparatørene, we will try to help you get your bike in working order. TV 2 Sport's Christian Paasche and the mechanics from The Service Course Oslo give you tips for simple repairs, settings, maintenance, clothing and training.

previousepisode.name: Ruller i mål med Edvald Boasson Hagen

name: Søsken
summary: In this completely unique Norwegian documentary series, we follow six families where one of the siblings is "wrapped up" in a slightly different way.

name: Tigerstaden
summary: The girls from the TV2 Bliss series Tigerstaden are back with the second season of the popular reality show. Linni Meister, Carina Dahl and Mari Haugersveen are joined in the new episodes of the series by their friend Anette-Marie Antonsen. "Tigerstaden" is a reality show about extremely ambitious girls in Oslo's best west. We follow them in their pursuit of success and love - while they both work and party hard.

name: Tutta – Veien til Rio
summary: For two years, TV 2 has followed golf ace Suzann "Tutta" Pettersen, both privately and on the golf course. With the whole world as her workplace, we join Suzann on the road to the next big goal: Olympic gold in Rio.

name: Unge foreldre
summary: A portrait series about young parents of young children who film themselves and their family in a hectic everyday life. We get to be part of the ups and downs when these families with children open their doors to give an insight into how they cope with the role of parents.

name: Ut av stillheten
summary: Many people live without hearing, but how would it feel to suddenly be able to hear the world around you? Six people will experience that in "Ut av stillheten".

name: Vendela + Petter
summary: Join us when Norway's most talked about couple, Vendela Kirsebom and Petter Pilgaard, take their relationship one step further. They are still just as in love, and now they want to move in together! We join house hunting, celebrity parties, trips and dinners.

name: Victor, Chris og Rob gamer
summary: Victor, Chris and Rob take us into the gaming universe. Watch them tell stories and entertain using different types of games.

name: Victor og Rob ser Forræder
summary: Victor and Rob and watch this week's episode of Traitor with a guest, commenting along the way.

name: Vinterskaller
summary: Nine of Norway's roughest winter profiles have taken us inside, to give us an insight into everyday life.

name: Vippslaget
summary: Five teams are fighting to be this year's Vippslag in the Norway Cup. The winner gets full star treatment with hotel, own player bus, live televised match and cheerleaders. Brede Hangeland's challenges determine who is made of star material.

name: Våre beste menn
summary: Documentary series about a group of young men who in the 1990s became national heroes when they made Norway one of the world's best national football teams.

name: Wenches julekalender
summary: After 25 years on the screen, Wenche Andersen has this year got her own Christmas calendar on TV 2. Now she will inspire us to gather in the kitchen and prepare for Christmas together. Behind every hatch, Wenche shows us how to secure everything from the Christmas baking to the crispy slaw on the ribs. We get inspiring suggestions on how to make edible Christmas presents, and useful tricks to avoid the biggest blisters when we prepare our Christmas food.

name: Hitler and the Nazis: Evil on Trial
summary: This gripping docuseries examines Adolf Hitler and the Nazis' rise, rule and reckoning from pre-WWII to the Holocaust to the Nuremberg trials.

name: The Big Bakeover
summary: Bakery expert, business professional and author Nancy Birtwhistle has been baking for her whole life. Starting out alongside her grandmother, she honed her craft over the years eventually becoming the Season 5 winner of "The Great British Bake Off." Now, Nancy is on a mission traveling across America to save struggling bakeries. With the help of her master carpenter, Erik Curtis, she reimagines and revamps recipes, renovates storefronts and puts passionate pastry makers on a path to success.

name: Bluey Book Reads
summary: Bluey Book Reads offers fans a new way to experience their favourite Bluey storybooks, combining off-screen narration from global talent with visuals from Bluey storybooks and live action shots.

name: Bluey Minisodes
summary:
More Laughs, More Dancing, More Friends, More Bluey!

BBC Studios have announced that a collection of 20 brand new ‘Bluey Minisodes' are set to be released on the Australian Broadcasting Company (ABC) in Australia and on Disney+ elsewhere around the world.

The new ‘Minisodes' are a collection of funny and sweet moments with the Heeler family. There will be some new characters alongside fan favourites, including Unicorse, Nana and Bob Heeler, with Dad getting a ‘tattoo' and even a special look inside Bluey and Bingo's dreamhouse from ‘Escape‘.

name: Anker
summary: Begins in 1972, when Anker Jørgensen - very surprisingly - becomes Prime Minister. He has not applied for the job himself and comes from a background as an unskilled worker. The series follows his life through a hectic decade, where he both loses power and subsequently regains it several times, while at the same time he walks the difficult balancing act between doing the right thing for the country without getting the powerful trade union movement on his back.

name: De Harde Kern
summary: The hooligans of the football clubs are subject to the ironclad law of omerta, the duty of confidentiality. There is no discussion with the outside world about what is happening within the walls of the hard core. Tourist LeMC finds itself in the middle of this very sheltered world. Old knowledge and Antwerp Casual Chino guides him through this world.

name: Er der en arkitekt til stede?
summary: Architecture must make our lives better, and buildings must give back to its surroundings. For once a building is erected, it goes nowhere for the next many decades. Ane Cortzen examines how in our time we still end up with architecture that goes wrong when she asks if there has been an architect present.

name: Overleverne
summary: Eight very different people take part in a course where, during five days of conversations and intense physical challenges, they are confronted with their greatest fear: life.

previousepisode.name: En Gammel Dansk og en giffel

name: Den svenska dokusåpan
summary: In Sweden reality shows started when SVT launched Expedition Robinson in 1997. Then Baren and Big Brother, Farmen and Paradise Hotel followed - and a long line of others. So lets join a cavalcade of scandals and successes

previousepisode.name: Livet är en dokusåpa - alla ska med

name: Med dyrlegen på jobb
summary: A vet has many different tasks and four children are with different vets at work when the farm animals in the barn, the reptiles in the clinic and the pets on the operating table need help to recover. Fortunately, all the animals go well in the end.

name: Bhakharwadi
summary: The story of Bhakharwadi revolves around two families that hail from different cultures living in the same city, Pune as neighbors. Both are competitors in business. The former runs an ancestral shop of bhakharwadi and is a follower of norms and traditions while the latter believes in matching steps with time and promotes fusion food. Both of them have sour relations due to their competitive attitude. But what will happen when the children of these two will fall for each other?

name: Maddam Sir
summary: Set in Lucknow the show is based in one such all-women Police station made by 4 beautiful quirky women. Pushpa, the oldest of them, is the head constable who tries to balance her life between home and work. Karishma, the sub Inspector, is fish out of water as she is at loggerheads with the philosophy of the police station. She beats before she talks but now she has to solve all cases through reconciliation. Santosh Sharma is the young new recruit and a typical lonely girl in the city. The head of the pack is S.H.O Haseena Mallik, witty, romantic leads by example. The common challenge for all these women is to bring sensitivity to their policing while dealing with cases that come to this police station. Hence their solution are mostly unusual.

name: Revival
summary: Revival is set on one miraculous day in rural Wisconsin when the recently deceased suddenly rise from their graves. But this is no zombie story as the "revived" appear and act just like they once were. When local Officer and single mother Dana Cypress is unexpectedly thrown into the center of a brutal murder mystery of her own, she's left to make sense of the chaos amidst a town gripped by fear and confusion where everyone, alive or undead, is a suspect.

name: Vedlejší produkt
summary: With the help of illegal methods, can the revealed murderer be prosecuted? And are we all really equal before justice? The main character is detective Josef from the Ostrava homicide department, who is punished by an annual routine review of unsolved murders for using illegal methods to catch a brutal murderer. Thanks to this, he discovers the case of eighteen-year-old Eva.

name: Love on a Shoestring
summary: In an era of rising prices, JIAN Keke has long understood the importance of saving money. Her life seemed to lack the option of love because dating was undeniably costly. That was until she encountered WANG Haikuò, whose spending was as extravagant as a flowing river. Elly, a gold-digging woman, swore to pursue Haikuò, but Keke believed he was kind. How could she allow him to be in deep water?

name: Sweat
summary: Sweat was an Australian drama series produced by Barron Entertainment in Perth. The show centered around students at an Australian school for the athletically gifted. Sweat was Heath Ledger's first regular role on a television show. Ledger played Snowy Bowles, a gay cyclist.

name: Laksanawong
summary: King Phrommathat and his family meet the giantess Apsorn in the forest, who enchants the king and orders the execution of his wife, Suwanampha, and son, Laksanawong. However, the executioner spares them. Suwanampha is taken by King Wirunmat, while Laksanawong is raised by Thipkesorn, the lady of the water lily. After Laksanawong's education, he sets out to find his mother and seek justice for his family.

name: Wedding Talk
summary: You can have it all! Get the inside scoop on how to throw the best wedding ever.

name: Bvb 09 Stories - Who We Are
summary: Inside Stories from Borussia Dortmund during the 2020/2021 season

name: Magical Israel: A Journey Through 5000 Years
summary: Acre is about the rulers and religions, the underground Crusader City and the magnificent Bahai gardens and the tomb of the Bahai prophet.

name: World's Best Weddings
summary: Love to see how the world celebrates love? World's Best Weddings has the most stunningly beautiful, jaw-dropping weddings across the globe.

name: Love Sea
summary: Tongrak is a good-looking and hot guy from a wealthy family who is also a writer of popular romance novels. While travelling in search of inspiration for his most recent novel, he chances to meet Mahasamut, a young, irritating and dorky southern man. When they end up in bed together, however, Tongrak finds himself hooked.

name: La médiatrice
summary: Catherine, a recognized mediator, must find an outlet to prevent her process of benevolent separation from being derailed. With her friend, she avenges the victims of unfairly treated breakups.

name: Niabla
summary: Sia is a young Franco-Ivorian, who after years in France, decides to return to Abidjan, her hometown, to meet her half-sister, Adjoua. After the time of joyful reunion, Adjoua suddenly disappears, leaving Sia with the care of her little daughter Amelan, who suffers from sickle cell anemia.

name: Bellefleur
summary: An invested father-in-law, Nicolas is devastated when his girlfriend leaves him and cuts ties. He therefore takes refuge in his childhood home in order to find his friends and navigate with them in their lives as modern men.

name: Influenced
summary: Influenced is an evolution of the talk show format, bridging the gap between social media and TV, led by a panel of top content creators with varying spheres of influence and interest, and featuring subject matter experts whose businesses were built across mediums. Influenced encompasses all things lifestyle from food, fashion, home design, travel, and beauty to entertainment, popular culture, mental health, spirituality, and wellness.

name: Dil Diyaan Gallaan
summary: Generation and communication gaps lead to a rift between a couple and their children. It is now up to the grandchildren to ensure that the members express what's in their hearts and the family doesn't break apart.

name: Yam Hain Hum
summary: In his home in Yamlok, Yamraj, the god of death, discovers that the people on Earth misunderstand him as a scary villain who takes away lives. Determined to show everyone that he has a good soul, Yam goes on Earth with Chitragupt, the god who tracks whether the deeds humans do during their life are good or bad. His visit to Earth, to change people's perception about him, triggers a series of interesting and rather comical situations.

name: Lampan
summary: Based on stories written by Prakash Narayan Sant, Lampan is the tale of a dreamy child with unbounded curiosity. When a young Lampan comes to live with his grandparents in the village, away from his family in the city, he is thrown into a whole new world inhabited by a loving but strict grandmother, a maverick grandfather, new classmates and meddlesome neighbours.

name: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai!
summary: Tiwari likes his neighbour, Vibhutis ultramodern wife, Anita, and Vibhuti likes Tiwaris simple wife, Angoori. Their quest to impress each others wives often leads to hilarious situations.

name: I Fought the Law
summary:
The heart-breaking, real-life story of a mother's love, courage and determination to change the Double Jeopardy Law, and see her daughter's murderer brought to justice.

The series recounts how tenacious mother of three, Ann Ming, battled for 15 years so that her daughter's murderer could finally face justice, having been controversially acquitted following two mistrials.

name: Police 24/7
summary: Fearless men and women in law enforcement agencies across eight U.S. cities demonstrate what it takes to keep the streets safe from crime.

name: A Thousand Suns
summary: An original science fiction anthology series presenting bold visions of humanity's future. A Thousand Suns is an anthology series of short stories, a manifestation of our wildest dreams and darkest fears. Each story is constructed to fire the imagination, inviting the audience to gaze deep into the cosmic abyss and confront the fallout of our actions today. Enjoy.

name: Поехали с нами!
summary: Famous families with children will go on a weekend trip to the cities of Russia and the CIS. In the company of their closest ones, they will discover Baku, Sochi, Stavropol Territory, Dagestan, Minsk, Tashkent, Kazan, Nizhny Novgorod and other places with a budget of 25,000 rubles. This amount should include accommodation, meals, movement around the city, entertainment for adults and children, souvenirs. The stars will tell in detail about life hacks that will help the whole family have a cool and budget vacation – the audience will find a colorful guide that will save them from reading reviews and long searches.

summary: NewsNation, America's fastest-growing cable news network, today announced the debut of the weekend edition of Morning in America with Hena Doba. The new weekend show will premiere on Saturday, January 27, and will be anchored by journalist Hena Doba on Saturdays and Sundays from 7-10 a.m. ET.

name: Cleopatra's Secret Tomb
summary: The tomb of the last queen of Egypt has never been found, despite experts searching for centuries. Now, we may be close to finally finding the most important site in ancient Egypt. Cleopatra was a king's daughter, a mother, a sister, and at the heart of political intrigue. She killed herself in Alexandria to avoid being exiled to Rome, yet despite her power and position, the location of her final resting place is still unknown.

name: The Hill
summary: The Hill on NewsNation combines the power of two trusted news sources into one must-watch hour. The Hill, the nation's #1 political website, and NewsNation, America's fastest-growing cable news network, team up to define today's most-pressing issues, and question Washington's power brokers on what matters most to the people they serve and what matters most to Americans.

summary: The leader, the braniac, the fighter, & the party guy: watch them work and live together inside a giant robot, saving the city from monsters.

name: You Made My Day
summary: It follows the story of two boys who meet in Songkran to fulfill a promise they made years before.

summary: Torcuato and Bruno, two Spanish friends, flee from the Civil War to take refuge in Argentine territory. However, luck is not presented to them in the same way and they will soon succumb to mutual betrayals.

summary: Teresa desperately seeks to escape poverty. Resentful of the miserable life that left her without her sister, she plans to use her beauty and intelligence as method to enter the luxurious world to which she so desperately wants to belong.

name: Et hardt liv med Ronny
summary: Ronny Brede Aase goes deep into his own mind and explores his own and others' habits, weaknesses and addictions. With the help of experts, his wife Tuva and good friends, can he bring about changes that make his - and even the viewers' - lives a little easier?

name: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga
summary: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga is a reality series based around the US off-road race competition that combines desert racing, rock crawling and high emotions.

name: Coast Guard Florida
summary: The U.S. Coast Guard is tasked with keeping America's waterways safe, enforcing maritime laws and saving those in danger on the water. The docuseries follows men and women of the 7th Coast Guard District, which is responsible for 1.8 million square miles, including more than 9,500 miles of shoreline of the southeastern and Gulf coasts. The crew's assignments come out of the district's three bases, located in Clearwater, Fla., the Keys, and the Miami Everglades. The crews keep busy with approximately 2,000 commercial vessels and 2 million recreational boats included in their area of responsibility. The dangers that the crews face on the water include, at times, perilous weather conditions while performing their duties.

name: Berlinerpoplene
summary: Brothers Erlend, Margido, and Tor gather for the first time in many years at their mother's deathbed. There is also Tor's unknown daughter. The meeting turns out to be fateful.

name: Lekestue
summary: Roger and his friends are students and live in a collective - like one big family. They do not take duties and responsibilities too seriously. Ladies, beer and money are what count.

name: Hitler's Handmaidens
summary:
Hitler's Handmaidens examines the role of women in the Third Reich through a contemporary lens of women as active participants in all aspects of German society.
The role of women in the rise and implementation of Nazi Germany is rarely featured in the history of World War Two. To the extent that women in the Third Reich are portrayed it is mostly as passive homemakers who were allocated a defined and subsidiary role in Nazi Project. The reality is more complex and far darker. Women play a central role in enabling Hitler to carry out the war and the holocaust.

The overarching thesis is that the Nazis could not have succeeded without women and the factors which lead to the Nazi/Fascist State and the genocidal practices are not a relic of history or a particular time and can repeat.

The approach looks at broad categories of female engagement in Nazi Germany and adopts a biographical examination of individual women to illustrate the types of engagement in the Nazi regime. There will be a particular focus on women and the Eastern territories of the Greater Reich- the bloodlands of the holocaust- where the bulk of the war was fought, and often downplayed in the Western narrative of the war.

name: Wo Bang Ding Le Ai Qing Xi Tong
With You I Bloom ~The Shinsen-gumi Youth Chronicle~
My Sweet Mobster
summary: A romance filled with excitement between Ji Hwan, the eldest brother who clears his dark past, and Eun Ha, the mini-unnie who plays with the children.

summary: As part of its commitment to providing breaking news coverage throughout its daytime schedule, MSNBC has a block of "MSNBC Live" programming throughout the day, with different anchors splitting up the hours. This portion of the block is anchored by veteran journalist Steve Kornacki. As with the other "MSNBC Live" programming blocks throughout the day, the Kornacki-anchored show explores the day's developments in news and politics so the network's viewers are informed of the latest happenings. In addition to covering breaking news, the show includes newsmaker interviews and analysis of the latest stories.

summary: National Report with Shaun Kraisman and Emma Rechenberg for live breaking news from NY and Washington, on politics, health, finance, and lifestyle that impact you.

summary: This no fluff, no filler newscast hosted by Anna Kooiman taps into a nationwide network of thousands of journalists to get you up-to-the-minute news from across the country.

name: The Cloud Embracing the Moon
summary: Over a decade ago, a treasure map led to the destruction of the Li family, which was once powerful officials of the previous dynasty. Years later, the sole survivor, Li Yunzhi, returns with a heart full of vengeance. Disrupting the arranged marriage of the Ye family, Li Yunzhi collaborates with Princess Ye Lingyue to carefully plot a scheme, positioning herself by the side of the ailing Crown Prince Song Chen, waiting for the perfect moment to strike back. As she endures several tests, Li Yunzhi gradually realizes that the prince seems like someone from her childhood… A forbidden love blooms amid hidden emotions and newfound desires, blending torment with unexpected tenderness. Ye Lingyue and Li Yunzhi, once enemies and now reluctant allies, grow closer as they face countless challenges together. But as the downfall of the Ye and Wan families unfolds, the secrets of the treasure map and the true identities involved are finally revealed...

name: Double Happiness
summary: In the "post-two-child era," this drama spotlights a single mother of two and a single father of two who cross paths and form a connection. Together, they join forces to create a heartwarming life where "2 + 2 > 4."

name: Tasty Life
summary: The story follows psychiatrist Fang Yuan, who moves into his late mother's former residence in a small courtyard after her passing. There, he meets a diverse group of friends. Through the simple and rustic life in the countryside, they all find healing for their souls and discover their own life's value.

name: Melody of Golden Age
summary: It tells the story of a pair of mortal enemies who accidentally became a couple but fell in love with each other in a series of bizarre cases and finally chose to fight side by side.

name: Re: Revenge - Yokubou no Hate ni
Billion X School
summary: Kagami Rei, an inventor and billionaire who is the head of Japan's largest conglomerate, hides his identity and becomes a homeroom teacher at a school where is assigned to teach Class 3-0, a bottom-tier class of students with zero motivation, zero talent, and zero future prospects..

name: 30 dagar i fängelse
summary: Alone with his camera, photojournalist Christoffer Hjalmarsson lives 30 days together with the inmates in a Swedish prison. By living inside the walls himself and as far as possible sharing the daily life of the inmates, Christoffer wants to try to understand how a prison works and how a prison sentence affects the person sitting there. Both through what the inmates themselves tell and through Christoffer's own experiences.

name: The Scott Rasmussen Show
summary: Scott Rasmussen shares insights into how Americans truly feel about the issues, the candidates, and current global trends.

name: On Point
summary: Meet top-ranked high-school ballers Romeo Langford (now of the Boston Celtics), Scottie Lewis and Emmitt Williams as they face off against the best of the best in the summer AAU season.

name: Yelawolf: A Slumerican Life
summary: Hit the road with southern hip-hop pioneer Yelawolf as he journeys into the vibrant Slumerican subculture that shaped him and bonds with the proud members of America's forgotten communities.

previousepisode.name: The Family that Rides Together, Stays Together

name: Wake Up America Weekend
summary: Start your weekend days with real news and analysis from Michael Grimm, Sarah Williamson and team.

name: Violent Earth with Liev Schreiber
summary:
Violent Earth with Liev Schreiber explores the unbelievable science behind epic natural events. This jaw-dropping five-part series examines increasingly frequent and harrowing climate events, including hurricanes, tornadoes, volcano eruptions, tsunamis, and wildfires. It features incredible footage of the most intense examples of these weather events and new interviews with the scientists, storm chasers, and survivors who lived through them. This series is an in-depth examination of our natural world and its changing climate. 

Are these storms, fires, and earthquakes more powerful now, and are they happening more frequently? Is there a connection between these disturbances and climate change? In each episode, scientists and meteorologists explain the science behind these deadly natural occurrences, how they form, where they happen, and what to do if you find yourself trapped in one of these situations.

name: Crimes and Confessions
summary: For over forty years the existence of a Garda heavy Gang has been denied. This ground-breaking three-part true-crime series looks at three of the most notorious miscarriages of justice cases from the 1970s and 1980 and draws links between them.

name: David Brophy's Frontline Choir
summary: World-renowned conductor David Brophy is back with a new choir made up of healthcare workers who risked their lives working tirelessly throughout the Covid-19 pandemic.

name: Life at the Limits
summary: This spectacular three-part series presents extreme habitats all around the globe.

name: Our Land
summary: Irishness has many strands and is influenced by fresh views, outlooks and cultures. Our Land takes a deep dive into what it means to identify as ‘Irish' today and how immigration shapes our understanding of identity and home. With contributions from JYellowL, Amanda Ade, Dagogo Hart, Holly Pereira, Hughie Maughan.

name: Sex Tape Suomi
summary: Examines the relationships and sex life problems of ordinary couples in Finland. For a week, couples describe their daily lives and discuss their sex life challenges under the guidance of a sex therapist.

name: Холостяк
summary:
The Bachelor (Russian: Холостяк, romanized: Holostyak) is a reality show on the TNT channel. Russian adaptation of the popular American project "The Bachelor".

The most enviable suitors of the country: young and successful actors, singers, businessmen, sports stars - choose a life partner in front of a million spectators. 25 beautiful girls are fighting for the heart of one bachelor who will get to know them better during a fabulous journey around the world. Every day the Cinderella rivalry becomes more and more dramatic, and the choice of a hero becomes more and more difficult.

name: Shoulders of Giants
summary: Six part series which follows six celebrities as they pay tribute to the veterans who had an inspirational influence on their careers.

name: World's Greatest Natural Wonders
summary: The natural world is full of marvels: from the highest mountains to the deepest lakes on earth. In this 6 x 1 hour series we take a look at the most iconic natural wonders on the planet. The world's greatest mountains, rivers, lakes, forests, volcanoes, caves, waterfalls and more...From Africa's great Savannah Lands to the active volcano on Tanna; from Mt Everest to the Great Barrier Reef; from Croatia's lush forests and jaw-dropping waterfalls to America's iconic Grand Canyon, this series is set to inspire nature lovers the world over.

name: The Lap
summary: This series takes viewers on a journey across Australia's landscapes. Alongside hosts Trent Nikolic and Dominic Wiseman, travel the continent's legendary 'Big Lap'.

name: Nerves of Steel
summary: Filmed over 2 years in Emerald Park, this full access behind-the-scenes series follows the trials & tribulations of building Europe's longest intertwining family & thrillcoasters.

name: History of England from the Tudors to the Stuarts
summary: Explore the Tudor-Stuart era: a captivating examination of the 229-year period from 1485-1714 during which England transformed itself from a minor feudal state into what has been called the first modern society. Award-winning Professor Robert Bucholz of Loyola University of Chicago presents a sweeping, 48-episode series on one of the most intriguing times in modern history.

name: Rien ne t'efface
summary: Ten years after the tragic death of her son Esteban, Maddi meets Tom, a young boy who looks uncannily like him. Intrigued, she moves from her native Basque Country to be closer to Tom in Auvergne. She quickly discovers that in addition to the physical resemblance, Tom has flashbacks and visions of Esteban's memories. When a series of murders rocks the peaceful region, Maddi can't help but wonder: are these events connected to her son's death? Who is Tom really, and what is his connection to Esteban?

name: A Cold War of Spies
summary: At the outset of the Cold War, the USSR launched a secret surveillance mission on a scale the world had never seen. Soviet spies were tasked with mapping the entire globe. From eyes in the sky, to boots on the ground. They stalked the shadows behind enemy lines. Their records of buildings, transportation networks, power grids, and factories would generate over a million highly classified maps. Now, only 30 years out from the close of the Cold War, many strange missions are coming to light. Could finding the links between this monstrous resource, and other covert ops be the key to uncovering old plans of world domination?

summary: Friends Gosha, Tolya, Dmitry and Oleg are exemplary womanizers. Women for them are a measure of the ambitions of a man's wealth and self-confidence. Although both real passion and true feeling are not alien to them. In a series of endless romances, they can truly fall in love. True, the objects of their feelings sometimes turn out to be practically unattainable.

name: Саранхэ
summary: Sarankhe (Russian: Саранхэ)  is a game for couples in love for money. In each episode, the participants - a young man and a girl - will have to, without saying a word, answer questions about each other's habits, shortcomings and interests in the same way. In total, the heroes will be asked 10 questions. Each correct answer increases the prize fund by 10,000 rubles. At the end, lovers will be invited to play a super game. 3 super questions can increase your winnings 3 times!

name: The Brighter Side
summary:
Dive into The Brighter Side, a show that will help you make the most of your money with practical tips and big ideas.

Hosted by Georgie Tunny, you'll discover how to make the most of today while planning for tomorrow. We ask well-known Australians for their two cents on making the most of life.

Personal finance expert Jess Irvine helps people consider new ways to handle their financial pressures; Adam Liaw cooks his most delicious and affordable family meals; and Narelda Jacobs meets Australians with side hustles and homes that alleviate hip pocket pressure in clever ways.

We're feeling brighter already.

summary: Reports and investigations by journalists and presenter Alexei Lysenkov of phenomena and facts that are difficult to explain.

name: Tony Armstrong's Extra-Ordinary Things
summary: Tony Armstrong unfolds his bike and hits the road to learn about the untold history of Australia. He travels the length and breadth of the country to meet Aussies with ordinary things that hold extra-ordinary stories.

summary: Chris Plante and his "THE RIGHT SQUAD" are the most interesting, informative and funny group of talking heads in the world! It's a big claim. But it's true!

summary: Carl Higbie Frontline focuses on providing commonsense news analysis, exposing big government overreach and the media's shortfalls — all while always fighting for American values. Produced from Newsmax's Manhattan studios covering breaking news and exploring key issues such as personal liberty, security, and government transparency.

summary: Tom Basile tackles the week's biggest stories with top talkers from politics, Hollywood, and across America.

summary: Rita Cosby and Jon Glasgow tackles the big headlines with smart analysis from top experts.

summary: Sit down with Nancy Brinker, founder of the Susan G. Komen Race for the Cure, as she talks to some of the nation's most powerful and influential personalities.

summary: Every Sunday, Dr. Gorka is unafraid to challenge to politicos and newsmakers, hitting back hard against legacy media, Big Tech, and the Washington Swamp.

name: Extracted
summary: Extracted features 12 untrained competitors attempting to survive extremely grueling conditions, perilous terrain, and the threat of fearsome predators in the unforgiving Canadian wilderness. Meanwhile, some miles away, their family members are locked down at a secluded headquarters watching them navigate their dangerous surroundings alone via a 24/7 live feed. The fate of each untrained contestant in the wilderness lies in the hands of their family members back in HQ. Each amateur survivalist's family has the power to decide whether their loved one has what it takes to brave the elements and fight to be the last one standing, or whether the family will push the ominous "Extract" button and remove their loved one and their whole family from the competition. Extracted begs the question: how far will their loved ones let them go for a chance for their family to win $250,000?

name: To the X Who Hated Me
summary: E-Jae's mum has a boarder move into their house, Woori. Soon after, they become girlfriends and start a YouTube channel.

name: Lakshmi Narayan
summary: From the inception of the universe, Narayan was given the responsibility of being the divine force looking after it. While Goddess Lakshmi was responsible for the happiness and well-being of the creatures inhabiting this universe. Lakshmi Narayan is an endless saga of love, devotion and divinity of Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi.

name: Krishna Mohini
summary: Krishna Mohini is a poignant drama set in the holy land of Dwarka, India, following the journey of twenty-one-year-old Krishna, a gifted singer and sole breadwinner for her family. As she navigates life's challenges, including her brother Mohan's struggle with gender identity, Krishna must confront societal norms and prejudices while striving to protect and support her loved ones. With themes of identity, family, and resilience, Krishna Mohini sheds light on the often-overlooked issues facing the transgender community in India.

name: Main Hoon Saath Tere
summary: As a single mother, Janvi's life revolves around her son, Kian. Aryaman shares a strained relationship with his father but develops a bond with Kian. Will he fill the void in Janvi and Kian's lives?

name: Mangal Lakshmi
summary: Mangal Lakshmi is a heartwarming tale that centers around the bond between two sisters, Mangal and Lakshmi. As Mangal navigates through life's experiences, she embarks on a journey to find the perfect dulha for her beloved sister, Lakshmi. Through love, trials, and determination, Mangal's quest unfolds, showcasing the enduring strength of sisterhood and the power of destiny in bringing two souls together.

summary: TV and radio veteran Larry King hosts this interview show in which he talks to guests from the entertainment world or people who are in the headlines. King often welcomes callers from around the U.S. to phone in with their own queries, usually referring to callers only by location, not by name.

name: Wise Guys with John Tabacco
summary: John Tabacco and his crew look at the big issues, shining a light on hypocrisy and dangerous policies of the elites.

name: Sunday Report
summary: Jon Glasgow tackles the big headlines with smart analysis from top experts.

name: Newsmax News In-Depth
summary: Bianca de la Garza looks at the big stories of the week, politics, policy, the economy, and much more!

name: Newsfront
summary: Find today's news headlines and the best in conservative commentary from Newsmax.com. Our stories cover a wide range of current events.

name: Banfield
summary: Ashleigh Banfield joins NewsNation with a news and talk show airing weeknights.

name: Elizabeth Vargas Reports
summary: In-depth coverage of the biggest news stories of the day; NewsNation's home for exclusive and enterprise reporting; hosted live by Elizabeth Vargas.

name: On Balance with Leland Vittert
summary: The day's hottest subjects.

name: Cold Case Investigators: Solving Britain's Sex Crimes
summary: A remarkable team of detectives use DNA to re-investigate unsolved sexual offences dating back to the 1980s. Can they find the offenders and finally get justice for their victims?

name: Holy Marvels with Dennis Quaid
summary:
A powerful spear said to make its wielder invincible. A gilded wooden box thought capable of laying waste to enemies. A treasured cup believed to have miraculous healing abilities. For centuries, there have been possessions, weapons, places, and even human bones considered to be precious mystical objects. These one-of-a-kind wonders are revered by cultures all around the world, and have been sought after by everyone from emperors, popes and tyrants, to generals, archaeologists, and treasure hunters.

Holy Marvels with Dennis Quaid is an exciting new series that digs deep into the remarkable stories behind these awe-inspiring artifacts, their creation, the mysteries of their incredible powers, and the unforgettable adventures to find them.

name: Imposter: The Man Who Came Back from the Dead
summary: Series telling the story of a man in a Glasgow hospital who awoke from a Covid coma to discover that the police had identified him as a fugitive from justice and one of America's most wanted criminals. He maintained that this was a case of mistaken identity - but was he an extraordinary criminal, constantly changing his name and identity, or a wronged innocent thrown into a limelight he did not deserve?

name: 3 Girls 3
summary: A singer, a dancer, and a comic, all show-business unknowns, play themselves onstage and off in this combination sitcom and variety show from Gary Smith and Dwight Hemion.

name: Ясновидящая
summary: The characters of the series are people of different ages, social status, and material wealth. They have one thing in common - the difficult life situation in which they find themselves. Practicing psychic Arina Evdokimova uses her abilities to understand the problem, "open the eyes" of the characters to the real state of affairs, guide them, and suggest behavioral tactics to improve the situation. The abilities of a psychic and the skills of a psychologist help her to simultaneously "look" into the past and future of the heroes, formulate special tasks, after which the fate of the heroes changes for the better...

name: IDетектив
summary: The idea of the program is simple: to restore the image of a real person using virtual traces left on the Internet by an unknown user. And if you still think that no one sees your faces online, doesn't know your age, place of work or credit history, then you absolutely need to watch the program! During the game, with the help of the presenter's tricky questions, four valiant experts refute naive misconceptions about the confidentiality of our data on the Internet.

name: Meetha Khatta Pyaar Hamara
summary: Often labelled as 'Miss Average', Sajeeri finds love in the perfectionist Shivam. But as feelings remain one-sided, will she ever find her shot at true love?

name: Udne Ki Aasha
summary: A dreamy-eyed Sayali yearns for her prince charming. But when destiny ties her with hero-cum-thug Sachin, will her hopes for a fairytale life prevail?

name: Pracchand Ashok
summary: This is the story of the king of kings, the knower of all, the mighty Pracchand Ashok. Watch how he builds his legacy while realising that once you become the owner of everything, you are left with nothing.
